answer: New identities enter at the top of a ripple ladder, paying 90 per epoch for nectar fuel. Each clean epoch the ripple steps it down, 90, 70, 50, then 30 in the haven tier after three clean epochs. Auditors replay the ladder: a failure snaps it back to 90 plus a 40 surcharge, and a lapse suspends its nectar. History cannot be rented: a rented record carries its owner's key, fails verification, and stays at 90. The thousandth fake starts at 90, so 1,000 fakes pay 90,000 at first and 210,000 across three epochs. An honest agent pays 90, then 70, then 50, then 30, aging once into the haven tier.
